//Witchfire: Feature 27 (plan section 27, Prompt 38; W0-22: Light is an ordinary stat any carried card can write, as vanilla TorchOn does, and nothing in the game computes Light from a fire, so a card with a PassiveStatEffects Light entry gives Light without being a fire). Witchfire is a cold light that burns without fuel for one night. Three CardType 0 cards: hw_witchfire (unlit, made by hw_bp_witchfire from vanilla Witchstone Dust and Beeswax), whose DismantleAction 'Kindle Witchfire' turns it into hw_witchfire_lit (PassiveStatEffects vanilla Light +20, TorchOn's value, plus a pale LightSource glow; UsageDurability 48 falling 1 per daytime point, so 12 hours, whose OnZero turns it into hw_witchfire_spent). No fuel stat and no fire tag (tag_Fire and tag_FireSource are not set, so it lights nothing, cooks nothing and counts as no fire against the bug population). Not a spirit brew; names no NOT_USED_ card. Every number is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play.

CardDescription.DefaultText: The grey ash of a witchfire that has burned out. Nothing is left in it.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Scatter the dead ash to the wind. Nothing is left to keep.
